svg.title: NET-03-P — Editable dedicated pilot setup
svg.desc: NET-03-PUBLIC-EDIT on the existing 850 by 700 logical desktop canvas. Fixed banner, service type, editable address, separate Port and masked Invite, two independently scrolling local setup panels, persistent validation and centered Connect/Back. Initial service-type focus. Production is an editable default, not a connected state.

g.text: The first admitted participant controls the session.
Leaving as host ends the session. Server updates may end the session.
Local players: 1 • Session-only scores • Optional scripts disabled
ANNOTATIONS: Top-to-bottom reading; left list before right. Service type receives initial focus.
Focused fields scroll text; body lists scroll independently. Keep header, validation and footer fixed.
Staging/custom use the same Address field. Browser selection uses NET-03-E, not this default.
Shared security has no plaintext fallback. Player-hosted Password is not this pilot Invite.
